title: Lace Flutter Sleeve A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This lace midi dress feels elegant, polished, and easy to wear. The V-neckline frames the upper body beautifully, while the flutter sleeves add soft coverage and graceful movement. Finished with a defined waist and a flowing midi skirt, it is a lovely choice for wedding guest dressing, cocktail parties, and other special evening occasions.


Tips: Prioritize the bust measurement when selecting; the fabric is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches. Consider the waist measurement next, and disregard the hip measurement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
